scope: General four Resources name APIs from actual ARSC ownership/type/key metadata; no manifest/package profile and no per-application constants.

basis.implementation: Independent Rust implementation from Android public API and binary format contracts; no Android implementation source copied.

observed_blocker.result: Prior exact-NRO failure only; new implementation E2E is recorded separately.

implementation.identity: Exact owning table package name, type pool and entry key. Alias values are not followed; localized/SDK/density value selection does not alter identity. Conflicting keys/owners are not guessed.
implementation.ids: Legacy284-byte package headers default typeIdOffset to0; modern headers retain offset metadata. Effective types, package IDs and entry indices are checked rather than truncated. Type/key pools stay within their owning package.
implementation.missing: Missing/invalid application IDs and structurally invalid framework IDs throw Resources.NotFoundException with RuntimeException hierarchy.
implementation.system: Explicit verified metadata registry contains android:id/content=0x01020002 only. Unknown nonzero-type package01 IDs fail API_UNAVAILABLE because the full framework table is unavailable; valid unsupported resources are not declared absent.

checks.name: sdk_fixture

fixture.reference: Actual aapt2-generated IDs/names/table owners, not a self-generated expected parser format. Android reference-runtime execution has not been run.

limitations: Full framework resource table, overlay/inherited symbol-pool composition and dynamic library resource remapping are unavailable.
This adds metadata APIs only; it does not make every referenced resource value, Android service or game executable.
Host portable DEX and parser proofs do not establish Horizon/emulator or physical hardware execution for this new source.
